title: Crypto misuse: HMAC sess_init error paths kfree without memzero_explicit on key_bytes
description: In hmac_sess_init() (src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_hmac.c line 114): memcpy(ctx->key_bytes, key, keylen) before wolfCrypt init. Two error paths then call kfree(ctx) without memzero_explicit: (1) wc_HmacInit failure (~line 119-121): kfree(ctx) — key_bytes not zeroed; (2) wc_HmacSetKey failure (~line 125-129): wc_HmacFree + kfree(ctx) — key_bytes not zeroed. FIPS 140-3 requirement: key material must be zeroized before memory is released. Fix: add memzero_explicit(ctx, sizeof(*ctx)) before each kfree on error paths.
